Package meta1

Interface RMIGatewayClientsInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIGateway
public interface RMIGatewayClientsInterface extends Remote
The RMIGatewayClientsInterface interface defines the methods that can be invoked remotely on a RMIGatewayClients object. It extends the Remote interface to indicate that these methods can be invoked remotely. This interface is a way for the clients to communicate with the Gateway.
